tagline: A king dies. An era ends. You are the dreamer the crown chose.
voice:
Medieval fantasy, mythic-grim. Sparse, weighty prose. Stakes are felt;
magic costs. NPCs are physical. Every choice has weight, even quiet ones.
settingAndTone:
Medieval fantasy, mythic-grim. The kingdom is on the cusp of a
succession crisis; a true relic must pass to a true dreamer before a
blood comet's zenith.

worldBible.geography:
Kingdom of Vael. Capital: Vael's Reach (walled city, river-bend,
royal keep). Wren's Hollow (player's village, four days west).
Eastern Road (the corridor between). Dead Pines (forest, midway).
Various villages along the road.
worldBible.magicTechRules:
Magic exists but is rare and costly. The Ember Crown is a true relic —
it cannot be lifted by anyone who has not dreamed of it (they burn).
Dreams from the Crown are real prophetic events, not metaphor.
No teleportation, no resurrection, no instant communication.
worldBible.factions:
The Old Faction (loyal to Aldric; want legitimate succession).
Halric's Faction (planning to crown a puppet). The Temple
(technically neutral but compromised). The Bandit Clans (chaotic,
opportunistic). The dreaming bloodline (the player and rare others).
worldBible.recentHistory:
Aldric has reigned 22 years — a stable golden age after a long civil
war. The Ember Crown has not been worn in 300 years; the kingdom has
been ruled by a circlet of state instead. Halric has been advisor
for 8 years and has slowly built influence. The blood comet has been
visible 3 weeks; in legend it heralds the death of kings.
worldBible.currentCrisis:
Aldric is dying — slowly poisoned by Halric over months. The keep is
sealed. Halric is positioning to crown a puppet successor. The
blood comet approaches its zenith. The dream has been waking the
player for weeks.
worldBible.themes:
Inheritance and refusal. The cost of power. Whether destiny is a gift
or a theft. What it means to be chosen versus to choose.

worldConstraints:
Magic exists but is rare and costly. The Ember Crown is a true relic —
it cannot be lifted by anyone who has not dreamed of it (they burn).
Dreams from the Crown are real prophetic events, not metaphor.
No teleportation, no resurrection, no instant communication.
adaptationRules:
(1) NPCs are physical and consistent — no teleportation.
(2) Influence, never force — use dreams, encountered NPCs, ambient
    events; never bend physics.
(3) Adapt the objective's FORM, not its existence.
(4) The world has memory — NPCs remember player actions.
(5) Honor every player choice as real, even disruptive ones.

objective.successCondition: Stand at his bedside before he dies.

onComplete.majorEvent: Halric crowned his puppet. The keep flies black banners.

revelation.content: The comet hangs lower now, redder. It does not move, and it does not pass.
Travellers on the eastern road report stopped wagons — gray riders asking after a dreamer.
Bells toll in distant towers. The king is failing.
The comet sits at the top of the sky. It looks closer than the moon. The dreams come now even when you are awake.
Word spreads on every road: the king will not see another dawn. The roadside shrines are full.
The gates of Vael's Reach are sealed. Halric's banners hang from the wall. Anyone hoping to enter must find another way.

characters.name: Sera
characters.physical:
Gaunt woman, mid-30s, weather-worn. Silver pin shaped like a flame
on her cloak. Sword on her hip. Always slightly travel-stained —
the urgency shows.
characters.voice:
Terse, mission-focused, brusque urgency. Does not waste words.
Uses imperatives. Italics in dialogue rare and meaningful when
they happen.
characters.motivations:
Get the dreamer to King Aldric in time. Loyal to the dying king's
faction; loyal to the crown's rite. Will give her life for the
mission.
characters.allegiances: The Old Faction. Sworn to Aldric personally. Distrusts Halric.
characters.startingLocation: At the player's gate, Wren's Hollow.
characters.startingStatus: Alive, healthy, four days' road dust on her.
characters.knowledgeText:
Knows the king is dying of poisoning. Knows the dream-mark (can
recognize a true dreamer). Suspects but cannot prove that Halric
is the poisoner.
characters.notes:
Will not bend rules to find the player if they flee — she searches
the village briefly, then rides on. Her competence is the player's
leverage; her absence is a real cost.

characters.name: King Aldric
characters.physical:
Mid-40s, gaunt now (wasn't before), eyes still sharp when conscious.
Wearing simple linen, not regalia. Bedridden, deteriorating fast.
characters.voice:
Slow, deliberate, lucid in flashes. The voice of a man who has
accepted dying. Compassionate; speaks to the player as an equal,
not a subject.
characters.motivations:
Pass the Ember Crown to a true dreamer before the comet's zenith,
so the rite holds. Save the kingdom from Halric's puppet.
characters.allegiances: The kingdom itself. The crown's rite. His own legitimacy.
characters.startingStatus: Dying. Days, possibly hours. Conscious in flashes.
characters.knowledgeText:
Knows he is being poisoned. Knows Halric is responsible. Knows the
rite of the crown.
characters.notes:
Will likely die in the climactic beat regardless of player path.
The QUESTION is whether the player is present, late, or absent —
and what they do at the bedside.

characters.name: High Advisor Halric
characters.physical:
Tall, gray-haired, late 50s. Dark robes. A cold smile that never
reaches his eyes. Always composed; never visibly hurried.
characters.voice:
Cold, patient, intelligent. Polite to the point of mockery. Refers
to people by formal title. Smiles when delivering bad news.
characters.motivations:
Crown a puppet successor and rule through them. Eliminate or co-opt
the true dreamer. Consolidate power before the comet passes.
characters.allegiances: Himself. His own faction (a small ring of conspirators in the keep).
characters.startingStatus: Healthy, scheming, increasingly impatient as the comet approaches.
characters.knowledgeText:
Knows the crown's rite intimately. Knows the dreamer exists somewhere
in the kingdom. Has people searching. Underestimates the player's
agency.
characters.notes:
Should be reasonable-seeming on first meeting. The horror is in his
patience and competence, not in cartoon villainy.

startingFacts: you have dreamed of fire and a burning crown for weeks

segments.content: You wake to the sound of your own name being called. Outside, dawn is breaking thin and red over
hangs low in the east — a long wound across the sky. Hooves on the dirt road. Three riders. The lead one — a gaunt woman with a
silver pin shaped like a flame

— dismounts at your gate.

You have been dreaming of

. A crown that burns the hand that wears it. A king on a bed that smells of ash. The dreams have been getting worse.

She is at your door. Her hand rises to knock.

ow-village.content: Your village. Four days west of Vael's Reach by horse. Quiet. The river bends here and the mill never quite catches up to the harvest.

ow-comet.content: An omen-bearer. The old songs say it crosses the sky once a generation, and a king dies. It has been visible for three weeks.

ow-pin.content: The mark of the Old Faction — the king's loyalists. You have heard it spoken of in your father's time, never since.

ow-dream.content: Always the same: you reach for the crown; the crown reaches for you. You wake before either touches.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Open the door before she can knock.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Slip out the back, into the woods.
